Container.Name: mailarchive
Container.Overview: Zero-knowledge, self-hosted email archive. Export old mail as .eml files, drop them into the web app and browse them from any device. Everything is parsed, encrypted, indexed and searched in the browser; the server stores ciphertext only. One passphrase plus a recovery key, no server-side reset. The archive is plain files under the data path, so a backup is a copy.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app and API.

Config.Name: Archive
Config.Description: Where the encrypted archive lives. The container runs as nobody:users (99:100), so this path must be owned by that user; Unraid creates it that way.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Set to true when the app is reached over HTTPS (a reverse proxy such as SWAG or Nginx Proxy Manager). Marks the session cookie Secure; login will fail over plain HTTP while it is on.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Address or CIDR range of the reverse proxy, comma-separated for several. Connections from it are attributed to the client named in X-Forwarded-For, so the login rate limit counts per visitor rather than per proxy. Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: Login attempts per minute
Config.Description: Login, setup and rekey attempts allowed per address and minute.
